questions.q: When moving suddenly from a dark place to a bright one, vision temporarily decreases.
You must not drive in a way that causes danger or inconvenience to other vehicles or people.
When driving on snowy roads, avoid tire tracks and drive elsewhere.
questions.explanation: It is safer to drive in the tire tracks (ruts) on snowy roads.

questions.q: When driving at night, it is better to turn on the interior light.
questions.explanation: The interior light should be turned off to avoid glare and maintain visibility.

questions.q: When passing an oncoming vehicle at night, switch headlights to low beam.
On general roads, a person with a motorcycle license for less than one year must not carry a passenger.
The brakes of a motorcycle should basically use only the front brake.
questions.explanation: Both front and rear brakes should be used simultaneously for effective braking.

questions.q: In principle, parking is prohibited if there is less than 3.5 meters of clearance on the left side of the road.
questions.explanation: The clearance requirement applies to the right side, not the left.

questions.q: If the width of the roadside strip is 0.75 meters or less, stop the vehicle along the left edge of the road without entering the strip.
Parking or stopping is allowed in a tunnel only if there are designated lanes.
questions.explanation: Parking or stopping is prohibited in tunnels regardless of designated lanes.

questions.q: This sign indicates two-way traffic.
Parking or stopping is prohibited within tram tracks.
Within 5 meters of an intersection or its edges, parking is prohibited, but stopping is allowed.
questions.explanation: Both parking and stopping are prohibited within 5 meters of an intersection.

questions.q: When driving on highways, tire pressure should be slightly higher.
The hydroplaning phenomenon occurs during high-speed driving in rain, where tires lose traction, and steering or braking becomes ineffective.
This sign indicates a vehicle passage prohibition.
Small special vehicles cannot travel on expressways.
A vehicle towing an accident vehicle with a rope cannot travel on expressways.
Except for motorcycles, vehicle owners must secure a storage location within 5 kilometers of their primary place of use.
questions.explanation: The storage location must be within 2 kilometers.

questions.q: Parking or stopping is prohibited within 5 meters of a road curve.
A large motorcycle is a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine displacement exceeding 400cc.
A vehicle with a maximum load capacity of 3,000 kilograms is a quasi-medium vehicle.
Overtaking is prohibited on steep uphill slopes.
questions.explanation: Overtaking is not prohibited on steep uphill slopes.

questions.q: Overtaking is prohibited on steep downhill slopes.
Overtaking is prohibited in tunnels regardless of the presence of designated lanes.
questions.explanation: Overtaking is allowed in tunnels if there are designated lanes.

questions.q: When driving for long periods, it is advisable to take a break at least every 2 hours.
With a motorized bicycle license, you can drive a small special vehicle.
questions.explanation: A motorized bicycle license only allows driving motorized bicycles.

questions.q: Commercial vehicles such as buses and taxis must undergo regular inspections every 3 months.
On a road with two lanes per direction, vehicles should generally travel in the right lane, keeping the left lane open for overtaking.
questions.explanation: Vehicles should travel in the left lane, keeping the right lane open for overtaking.

questions.q: Pedestrian roads can be used by driving slowly and paying attention to pedestrians without special permission.
questions.explanation: Vehicles cannot use pedestrian roads without special permission.

questions.q: In principle, vehicles cannot travel on tram tracks, but they may do so for right turns or unavoidable reasons like road construction.
When passing near a safety zone with pedestrians, vehicles must stop temporarily.
questions.explanation: Vehicles must proceed slowly, not stop, near safety zones with pedestrians.

questions.q: When passing a stopped vehicle, be cautious as its door may open suddenly.
When approaching a pedestrian crossing and it is clear no pedestrians are crossing, you may proceed without stopping.
When approaching a pedestrian crossing and it is unclear whether pedestrians are crossing, you must stop temporarily.
questions.explanation: You must proceed at a speed that allows stopping if necessary.

questions.q: The legal speed limit for towing a vehicle with a gross weight of 2,000 kg or less using a vehicle with at least three times that weight is 40 km/h.
When carrying children under 12 years old, three children are counted as one adult.
questions.explanation: Three children under 12 are counted as two adults.

questions.q: Fire trucks are not considered emergency vehicles.
questions.explanation: Fire trucks are included as emergency vehicles.

questions.q: When an emergency vehicle approaches near an intersection, move to the left side of the road, stop temporarily, and yield the way.
At an intersection of roads with similar widths, the vehicle on the left has priority.
A U-turn refers to turning the vehicle around.
When making a right or left turn, the signal must be stopped immediately after completing the action.
Stopping for more than 5 minutes for passengers to board or alight is considered parking.
questions.explanation: Stopping for passengers, regardless of duration, is considered stopping, not parking.

questions.q: Parking is prohibited within 1 meter of a fire alarm.
The legal speed limit for large cargo vehicles on expressways is 80 km/h.
If cargo falls onto a highway, request its removal via an emergency telephone and do not handle it yourself due to safety concerns.
Small special vehicles cannot travel on vehicle-only roads without a specified minimum speed.
questions.explanation: Small special vehicles are allowed on such roads.

questions.q: Ordinary motorcycles with a displacement of 125cc or less cannot travel on vehicle-only roads.
When driving, focus on a single point and avoid being distracted by surrounding traffic.
questions.explanation: Drivers should maintain awareness of surrounding traffic rather than focusing on a single point.

questions.q: Inertial force refers to the force acting between the tire and the road surface.
questions.explanation: Inertial force is the force that causes a vehicle to continue moving.
